<thought>From the isotopic pattern, the M+1 peak (~6.7% of base) matches the expected contribution of ~6 carbons (13C ~1.1% per C). No other element shows a distinctive isotopic signature (e.g., Cl, Br, S would give larger M+2 peaks). Thus carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
